item.description: Charleston, W.Va. (WOWK) -- The first of many proposed election integrity bills passed through the West Virginia State Senate on Monday. The version of the bill introduced by Sen. item.description: Senator Shelley Moore Capito (R-WV) visited WVU's innovation center in Morgantown on Monday to launch her campaign's Veterans Coalition.

item.title: National School Counseling Week honors the past, present and future of school counselors
item.description: Monday kicked off National School Counseling Week, putting a spotlight on school counselors both across the country and in West Virginia.

item.title: 8 West Virginia sites added to National Register of Historic Places
